text:
Everything happened as he had imagined
back there at the Smolensk front.
And you have aged, though you still smile
wie einst, Lili Marlen.

Haloed in mist, just as before,
your lovely face rises before me
against a background of tanks
and swastikas in the Place Vendôme.

At the bar, before a drink,
planted there like a decoy,
you smile obscenely.
At whom, Lili Marlen?

Defeated by the Russians and by years,
your angry heart still asks
you for war. And in the final hours
of solitude and alcohol,

enraged and thin, you use your nails
to tear the stitching of your black glove,
your old black gauntlet
with which you waved goodbye as you left.

translation.title: Ruins of the Third Reich
